item.title: 1.3 The Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neuron
item.description: The Leaky Integrate-and-Fire Neuron A spike event already gives an SNN a way to say, “something happened at this moment.” The next question is how a neuron decides that enough has happened to send one of those events onward.

item.title: 1.4 Conceptual Architecture of an SNN
item.description: A single spiking neuron can already turn accumulated input into a spike, but a useful system needs many such neurons arranged so that a raw signal can become a decision.
